note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated India customs export records with destination (Finland, Brazil), HS 85042100 and B/L numbers (9851855, 1040463) exist, and repeat buyers in Poland, Finland, Uruguay/Paraguay and Italy appear with shipment counts.
